eraId.description: must reference an existing era id (ContentLint dangling-ref check)

cost.description: must be >= max(prereq costs) (ContentLint cost-monotonicity check)

prereqIds.description: must reference existing tech ids, form a DAG (no cycles), and each prereq's era must be <= this tech's era (ContentLint reachability check)

foodBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — civ-wide percent multiplier on Food production, summed over a civ's completed techs by World.Advance() and applied by EconomyEngine.ProcessTurn. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

productionBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — civ-wide percent multiplier on Production. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.

goldBonusPercent.description: docs/content-design.md §0 — civ-wide percent multiplier on Gold. Structural sanity bound only, not a balance judgment.
